ck_audit_actor.name: ck_audit_actor
ck_audit_actor.value: "audit_log"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_log"."actor_system" IS NOT NULL

ck_timeline_actor_present.name: ck_timeline_actor_present
ck_timeline_actor_present.value: "timeline_event"."actor_user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "timeline_event"."actor_system" IS NOT NULL

uq_contact_cpf.name: uq_contact_cpf
uq_contact_cpf.where: "contact"."cpf" IS NOT NULL AND "contact"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "contact"."merged_into_id" IS NULL

ck_offer_renewal_requires_ref.name: ck_offer_renewal_requires_ref
ck_offer_renewal_requires_ref.value:
("offer"."type" = 'regular' AND "offer"."renews_offer_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("offer"."type" = 'renewal' AND "offer"."renews_offer_id" IS NOT NULL)

uq_offer_condition_default_per_offer.name: uq_offer_condition_default_per_offer
uq_offer_condition_default_per_offer.where: is_default = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

ck_offer_condition_item_ref_exclusive.name: ck_offer_condition_item_ref_exclusive
ck_offer_condition_item_ref_exclusive.value:
(
        "offer_condition_item"."product_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "offer_condition_item"."commercial_benefit_id" IS NULL
        AND "offer_condition_item"."kind" <> 'commercial_benefit'
      ) OR (
        "offer_condition_item"."product_id" IS NULL
        AND "offer_condition_item"."commercial_benefit_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "offer_condition_item"."kind" = 'commercial_benefit'
      )

ck_transaction_approved_coherence.name: ck_transaction_approved_coherence
ck_transaction_approved_coherence.value:
("transaction"."status" = 'approved'
           AND "transaction"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
           AND "transaction"."snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("transaction"."status" <> 'approved')

ck_refund_approved_coherence.name: ck_refund_approved_coherence
ck_refund_approved_coherence.value:
("refund"."status" = 'approved' AND "refund"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "refund"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("refund"."status" = 'processed' AND "refund"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("refund"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'processed'))

ck_installment_parent_exclusive.name: ck_installment_parent_exclusive
ck_installment_parent_exclusive.value:
("installment"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "installment"."subscription_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("installment"."transaction_id" IS NULL AND "installment"."subscription_id" IS NOT NULL)
